title: OPDC awarded £36m to keep thousands of homes warm with waste heat from data centres in UK first

values.quote: awarded £36 million from the government's Green Heat Network Fund (GHNF)
Old Oak West ... will deliver over 9,000 homes and 250,000m2 of commercial development.
This substantial scheme is expected to deliver 95GWh of heat across 5 phases between 2026 and 2040.

unsupported_wording: 'to heat over 9,000 homes from data centres' is not supported: 9,000 is the homes Old Oak West will deliver; the release says only 'thousands of homes' will be kept warm. Quoted phrase matches the source verbatim.
note: 95 GWh across 5 phases is not stated as annual; it is an expected (proposed) figure from the developer/funder. Page also notes almost £400,000 LEA funding and that the £36m is part of a wider £65m GHNF award.
